# Icon: `jl-icon`

A lucide icon by name, sized in pixels and coloured by its text.

- Class `JlIcon`, an atom: `import { JlIcon } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/icon

Icons come from lucide and follow the text colour, so they take the tone of whatever holds them. About eighty
names are built in (see the Icons page); add any other lucide icon with registerIcons.

An icon is decorative by default and hidden from screen readers. Give it a label only when it carries meaning on
its own, with no text beside it.

## Use

```ts
import { JlIcon } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlIcon name="sparkles" size={24} />
```

```html
<jl-icon name="sparkles" size="24"></jl-icon>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The icon to draw. An unknown name draws a neutral mark.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `number`, default `16`. Width and height, in pixels.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. What screen readers say. Without it the icon is decorative.
- `filled` (attribute `filled`): `boolean`, default `false`. A sign in a shape (circle-check, circle-x, info, triangle-alert) drawn as a solid badge: the shape in the colour, the sign cut out of it.

## Methods

- `registerIcons(icons: Record<string, IconNode>): void`: Adds icons by name to the ones every jl-icon knows. Import it from jlib.

## Styling

- `--cutout` (custom property): The colour of the sign of a filled icon: the surface colour.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Built-in icons

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-icon name="house"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="search"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="settings"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="bell"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="user"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="mail"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="calendar"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="heart"></jl-icon>
</div>
```

### Sizes

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-icon name="rocket" size="14"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="rocket" size="18"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="rocket" size="24"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="rocket" size="32"></jl-icon>
</div>
```

### Colour

An icon takes the colour of its text: set color on it or on what holds it.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-icon name="circle-check" size="20" style="color: var(--jl-ok)"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="triangle-alert" size="20" style="color: var(--jl-warn)"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="circle-x" size="20" style="color: var(--jl-danger)"></jl-icon>
  <jl-icon name="info" size="20" style="color: var(--jl-accent)"></jl-icon>
</div>
```

### Meaningful icon

With a label, the icon is an image with a name for screen readers.

```html
<jl-icon name="lock" label="Private" size="20"></jl-icon>
```
